description: This file defines functions and types related to creating and managing test reporters in the Playwright testing framework, including reporter creation, error collection, and command hashing.

classes.name: ErrorCollectingReporter
classes.description: A reporter that collects errors and outputs them to a screen.

methods.name: createReporters
methods.description: Creates an array of reporter instances based on configuration and mode.

methods.name: createReporterForTestServer
methods.description: Creates a reporter instance for a test server, with message sink integration.

methods.name: createErrorCollectingReporter
methods.description: Creates a reporter that collects errors and writes them to a screen.

methods.name: reporterOptions
methods.description: Generates reporter options based on configuration and mode.

methods.name: computeCommandHash
methods.description: Computes a hash representing the command configuration for reproducibility.
